name: inspiring_paladin_no_first_strike_on_opponents_turn
notes: M7 mapper. Printed: 'During your turn, this creature has first strike. During your turn, creatures you control with +1/+1 counters on them have first strike.' On seat 1's turn neither applies: Opp Ape One (3/3) attacks and seat 0's Bear with a +1/+1 counter (3/3) blocks it, Opp Ape Two (3/3) attacks and the Paladin (3/3) blocks it. No first strike: all four die.
